dev_totals.sql: SELECT count(*) AS loans, sum(default_24m) AS defaults FROM features_dev

dev_vintage_sums.sql: SELECT vintage_year, count(*) AS loans, sum(credit_score) AS sum_score, sum(dti) AS sum_dti, sum(orig_term) AS sum_term, round(avg(rate_spread), 6) AS avg_spread FROM features_dev GROUP BY vintage_year ORDER BY vintage_year

fresh_structure.sql: SELECT vintage_year, count(*) AS loans, count(DISTINCT loan_seq) AS distinct_loans, sum(credit_score) AS sum_score, min(first_payment_date) AS first_payment_min FROM features_fresh GROUP BY vintage_year ORDER BY vintage_year

raw_orig_loans.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT loan_seq) AS loans FROM raw_orig

raw_perf_rows.sql: SELECT count(*) AS monthly_rows FROM raw_perf

raw_perf_loans.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT loan_seq) AS loans FROM raw_perf
